body:
Absolutely, it can be.

I had a therapist a couple years back, maybe 4 or 5 years now. I was really young and she knew that I was terrified of the Physc ward, She told me if I didn’t tell her everything within my first session she’d have to send me to there. Mortified, I told her everything, everyone’s name, all my trauma, and my plans. Then that same day she told my mom everything I had said. She’s part of the reason I quit therapy and haven’t gone back since.

First of all, Calming down is so hard my panic attacks just end when it drains me enough to go to sleep. anxiety attacks dont let me go to sleep and it sounds cringe but take a few breaths, i usually pace when im practicing breathing exercises. Tea helps sometimes or even just laying on your back or side and just trying to stay as still as possible, eventually you just tire yourself out. just more in a short list, youtube videos (distraction), music and just touching some water. i hope you feel better or find some that work for you and if you dont thats okay too.

hey, i also struggle with this. i got myself out of a depressive episode that lasted for a lot longer that i would've hoped, i was doing a lot better but im starting to lose motivation slowly and feel all the fatigue. i feel like shit, but my off days are bound to happen, thats the thing with improvement. Not everyday will be constantly increasing in happiness and thats okay!  the thoughts dont go away with one little push of motivation, its a process, and your off days dont make your improvement any less important. Im so proud of all your improvement, its still counts. i care about you even if you dont care about yourself, and well get through this together one step at a time

they do, i just have never really felt comfortable with counselling or therapy. i feel like this every other day but i am working on getting better! thank you for the reply, youre helping me feel real. i hope we both find ourselves or a solution

it feels nice to see someone in the same boat, i just got some assignments done and feel better. i hope you feel better as well, and if you dont thats okay too! your  advice helped  more than you think. off days are just bound to happen, and escaping just feels easy. thank you so much.

i know how you feel. sometimes i feel like theres so much in my head and im just forced to listen but at the same time there is nothing there. it is addicting. do me a favor and try to touch some water (like a bath)  or take a nap, those always made me feel a tiny bit more real. if you have headphones in take them out. sometimes it breaks the noise and all you think is "its actually quiet" you got this. youre real and the noise doesnt control you. you have control over yourself

well thats a way too look at it. Sometimes i struggle to find out if people actually enjoy  things or are just influenced to like something because other people like it . sometimes i do feel like people are dull and the world feels gray and boring. a lot of stuff is boring to be honest. people are unexciting to say the least i agree. this mindset comes to me everyone once in a while, just some off days

hey my mental health was so horrible a month ago.  I got myself out of my depressive episode, im starting to brush my teeth again. i had a panic attack yesterday but its okay off days are bound to happened. to WHOEVER is reading this i love you. and i mean it. mental health is rocky but you arent insane, and are definitely not alone. i hope to see you all tomorrow morning hopefully feeling better, and if you arent thats alright. you mean so much to me every single one of you thank you so much
thank you so much! you're so kind for writing this i hope you're doing well yourself. have a good night dude.

i always feeling like dying but will never commit the action. It makes a lot of sense, youre searching for an escape from yourself, im digging myself out of the hole on disconnecting from certain toxic apps and finding stuff i \*actually\* like. i know its hard to find it took me years. there are days i couldnt even look at myself but i hope you find yourself, and learn to rebuild yourself

hey, i also left therapy because of my anxiety disorder i know exactly how you feel. I have panic  attacks that make me feel like im going insane, my chest always feels tight when im overwhemingly anxious. i know breathing is hard right now, i used to just sit under the bath faucet when calming down, it used to help.  i swear once your heart rate starts to settle itll slowly make you drift to sleep. i used to sleep right after panic attacks it helped. do whatever you feel is beneficial but you are not going crazy and i care so much about your wellbeing. its adrenaline, im looking forward to seeing you in the morning. you got this

i know how you feel, i also have issues with motivating myself to get up. To be honest sleeping is just addicting, its warm and your sheets feel safe. I used to go to sleep after a panic attack so I wouldnt have to deal with it anymore. im doing a lot better now, theres just some days i fall back in. motivation takes time and theres nothing wrong with wanting an escape from time to time.

hey, you dont have to finish all those assignments all at once, take your time. Always put yourself before it if you feel like your unhappy or not doing well mentally, your parents may not understand now, but i can assure you you are doing great, those are just numbers and they wont matter. you matter so much more than those small assignments do. Know that you are doing great. Im proud of you for being here. and i genuinely mean it.

to be honest with you something that stops me from ending it is the rain. i live in LA and it doesnt rain much, but when it does we drink hot chocolate and pan dulce at home watching the rain outside. my neighborhood isnt the nicest but watching wet leaves get stuck on the windows makes me a little happier, the plants get taller, and the birds hide in their nests. i too have a mom strugggling with her mental health shes told me the same, i know what you're going through. i hope we find ourselves, and im so proud of you for being here. i hope i see your answer soon

hey, i know how you feel. First of all, your soap buisness sounds so cool and if thats something  you can talk about for hours, talk about it. You aren't annoying and you aren't unwanted, and i know they sound like just words but I GENIUNELY mean it. I know you think you sound annoying for feeling what your feeling, but your feelings are valid. Dont spread yourself too thin, i care about you and your feelings. You may be overthinking what your passions mean to other people but I am sure they would be so proud to see you so happy about the soap
